_doc: perf_audit benchmark scenes (docs/PERF_AUDIT.md). setup: console lines run after the map loads (host). camera: spline keys [x, y, z, yaw deg (0 = -z), pitch deg] over the captured frames; orbit: a circle around the local player instead (maps without fixed coordinates). Every scene runs with the time paused, the weather locked, dev_fixed_fps 60 (one sim tick per frame: the same work in every run) and no vsync / frame cap.

scenes.desc: dev room hall, post corner, firing line (the bench_fidelity route)
500 horde zombies converging on a point in the horde yard
vegetation map: trees, grass, ground cover, wind
water yard in rain: water surfaces, wet shading, precipitation, rain occlusion
dev room at night: every local light, point / spot shadows, moon, no sun cascades
vehicle yard with a car and a motorbike

net._doc: 2-client LAN: tools/perf_audit/run_audit.sh runs a host with this scene and a client (+connect 127.0.0.1); both write profiles (the client's net section is empty, the host's holds the snapshot statistics).
